verdict.rationale: Token2 ships an official open-source CLI (fido2-manage) for managing FIDO2 devices, including scriptable operations (PIN/bio management, JSON/CSV export, SSH key handling) that could be invoked programmatically, but there is no evidence it is designed or marketed for AI-native/agentic workflows (no agent integration, no mention of automation-for-AI use cases, no MCP or scripting-first framing beyond basic export formats). missing for 10: explicit AI-native design intent, agent/automation integration examples, structured machine-readable I/O beyond CSV/JSON export, and independent corroboration of CLI use in agentic pipelines.
